channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Aug 24
item.description:
38 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Fixed UI pooling issue for vehicles, reducing UI glitches related to vehicle pooling.

Vehicles

  • Improved vehicle handling: refined suspension, steering and grip; removed burnout/launch attempt; engine revs now use front wheel speed; rear wheels lock during handbrake.
  • Helicopter passenger seat weapons now have aim sway that scales with movement speed.
  • Fixed UI pooling issue for vehicles, reducing UI glitches related to vehicle pooling.

Animals

  • Livestock now have a water need and will drink from nearby containers, rivers, or lakes.

Tool Cupboard

  • TC upkeep rate now scales with the number of authorized players: first 4 players add 0%, next 6 add 2% each, additional players add 4% each.

Gameplay

  • Random skin crafting now includes the default skin as a possible result.

UI

  • Store UI drawer bug fixed; missing image paths now fallback correctly, restoring proper display of store items.
  • Arrow icons refreshed and fixed, correcting visual inconsistencies in the UI.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Aug 23
item.description:
20 development commits

Items & Inventory

Equipment

Fuel & Dome

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Aug 22
item.description:
11 development commits

NPC & AI

  • Fixed heavy scientists getting stuck after being dropped by the helicopter on certain seeds (small oilrig).

Deployable Physics & Collisions

  • Fixed mismatched colliders and off‑center gib origins for multiple deployables (io.table, HotAirBalloon armor, sculpture.ice, mannequin, chandelier, component.box.charcoal.large, HotAirBalloon basket, refinery, windmill, wooden box, fireplace, lift shaft top, tool cupboard, cannon, component box wood), eliminating clipping and improving break‑apart physics.
  • Added gib pieces to the Frankenstein table so it now breaks apart correctly when destroyed.

Grenade Stack Sizes

  • Reduced stack sizes for F1 grenades, Bee grenades, Flashbangs, and Molotovs from 5 to 3.
